title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the credential carry-forward group out of protocol.ts into protocol-credential-carry-forward.ts (#25467 cut 9)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNBLp4i8Un5xSqTRfqBZH2G)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 9 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–8 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642 and #25719. The claim is `6391854672`; the scope is the carry-forward credential group the cut 8 report (`6391184870`) proposed from Release `6385903828`, as the server seat approved it.

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-credential-carry-forward.ts` (#23050 shape B; one getter, `credentialChannels`). `protocol.ts` loses 26 net lines (29,821 to 29,795). A fifth member of the group, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`, stays in the class (see "Readers of the moved lines"). The cut also replaces cut 7's placeholder header line in `protocol-package-install.ts` with a written header (comment only). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-uly5ki` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds one commit on `main` `e5cf9f049c`.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: none of the 19 open PRs touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` (each PR's file list read in full; #25718's 9,209-file list was checked by `git diff --name-only` against its merge base, since the files API caps at 3,000). `git log e5cf9f049c..origin/main -- packages/metadata-protocol/` is empty at `43edf90b5`; `main`'s two new commits touch other packages, and `git merge-tree` of this head with `origin/main` is clean.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credentialChannelFor` | `:6872` | private | 24 |
| `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` | `:9190` | private | 103 |
| `storedBodyForCarryForward` | `:9215` | private | 167 |
| `restoredCredentialPathsFor` | `:9264` | private | 202 |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–8 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position, less `async`. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25467 cut 9]`.
- **Typing.** `CredentialCarryForwardHost` types every member as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['m']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No cast, and no member changes visibility.
- **Members read:** the field `credentialChannels`, as a getter; the methods `credentialChannelFor`, `getOverlayRepo`, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `storedBodyForCarryForward`, as late-bound closures. No field is assigned.
- **`credentialChannelFor` moves cleanly**, as the order asked to measure first. Its other readers (the cut 8 host literals in `restoredBodyDerivation` and `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`, `saveMetaItem`, `promoteDraftForPublish`) still call the class method, which keeps its signature, so neither `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` nor `AuthoringGateHost` changes. No pin reads it by path.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **None moves, and none gains `export`.** No module-level declaration of `protocol.ts` is read by the moved bodies; everything they read comes from the module `protocol.ts` imports it from (`metadata-redaction.ts`, `@objectstack/spec/shared`). From `protocol.ts` the new module imports types only (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, `MetadataCredentialChannel`), so there is no runtime module cycle.
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** `carryForwardRedactedValues` and `redactedPathsCarriedForward` lose their last reader and leave the `metadata-redaction.js` import list (`hasMetadataRedactor` keeps a reader and stays). The one new statement is the import of the new module.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base `e5cf9f049c` and head `428f9aa9` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...'` once, then the package's `src/` swapped tree-only to base for the base build and restored from `HEAD` under a trap, `git diff HEAD` empty after).

- **Raw sha256**: `325970c1661efaa6a3762ce7de9e6bb205ea16099784f2b6c5950d62d175b331` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 772,838 bytes each (the hash cut 8 reported). `diff` exits 0. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too.
- **Normalised sha256**: `9562749edf7b8bba67ed2f1779799a68b3d6934a8605074934572d9507c55ba6` at both ends, both files (109 string-literal union runs sorted). This run's normaliser is its own script, so the hash is not comparable with cut 8's normalised figure; the raw hashes are.
- **The two builds differ** where they should: `index.js` hashes `12c3ff329045d303…` at base (cut 8's head hash) and `a41e81cf2349514e…` at head; `storedBodyForCarryForward.call` and `credentialChannelFor.call` each occur 0 times in the base bundle and once in the head bundle.
- **Positive control** on a copy of the head `index.d.ts`, the first `private engine;` changed to `engine;`: raw `3c2a24456c659dbf…`, normalised `66c9d4dcf48487eb…`. Both move.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. None of the moved functions or the host type appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token** (TypeScript scanner over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body): 496 tokens compared, **0 differ**. The parameter and body text, comments included, is also equal with whitespace collapsed, for all four. Negative control: one changed token in `restoredCredentialPathsFor`'s body (`held.length > 0` to `> 1`, on a copy) makes the check report `differ=1`.
- **Class side.** 299 members at base and at head. The 295 that did not move are byte-identical to base. Each of the 4 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical, less `async`.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 235 of the 236 base statements other than the class are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other one is the `metadata-redaction.js` import that loses two names. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +239 / −60 over 3 files, 299 changed lines. `protocol-credential-carry-forward.ts` has 164 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path (86 files) was grepped for each moved member's name and for the calls their bodies make.

- **`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`** records `readCodeLayerForCarryForward: lookupArtifactItem(type, name, pkg)` as a site it reads in `protocol.ts`, keyed by a four-space class-member header. Moving that body would take the site out of the file the pin reads and leave a forwarding closure (`this.lookupArtifactItem(...a)`) in its place. **Verdict: `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` stays in the class**, the same disposition the Release gives `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` for the same pin. `storedBodyForCarryForward` reaches it through the host. The pin is unchanged and green.
- **`protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites.test.ts`** censuses `this.getOverlayRepo()` acquisitions in `protocol.ts`. `restoredCredentialPathsFor`'s `const repo = this.getOverlayRepo();` is the census's exempt spelling and leaves with the body (14 to 13 such lines), and the body makes no stored-row write. **Verdict: no edit**, as cuts 5 and 6 moved the same line. The census stays green and keeps its population of writes.
- No other hit. No cross-package test or script names any moved member (the hypothesis in the order holds), and no `docs/` or `content/` page does.
- **Bracketed-refusal pin** (`PRODUCERS`): the new module has no `new Error(` (0), so it gets no row.
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check:adr-anchors` output is identical at both ends: 85 anchored files, **1,846 → 1,846** decision-letter citations. No paragraph of the `protocol.ts` anchor entry describes the carry-forward, so the new module gets no entry.
- **Durability checker** (`check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`): identical at both ends once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (159 lines). The gate exits 0 at both ends with identical output.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14065 → 14039, 14090 → 14064). `productionFiles` is 3,684 at base and 3,686 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, which the spec build writes in the head tree and the base tree had not built.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-uly5ki`: 0 of 3 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 299 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exits 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock):
  - Base `e5cf9f049c`: 21,504 tests (21,485 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 266 files.
  - Head `428f9aa9`: 21,504 tests (21,485 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 266 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `e5cf9f049c` and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status` clean after. The suite includes both pins named above (15 tests, all passed at head).
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 gates on 3 changed paths. 52 exit 0 at head. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (a pinned fixture commit outside the shallow clone; an unbuilt `objectql/dist`) and exit 0 once the commit was fetched and objectql built. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally: it needs every package's `dist/` and is left to CI; this package's CJS bundle was loaded directly above. `--ran` reconciles 53 of 53: 52 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- `protocol-package-install.ts` (cut 7) now carries a written header in the shape of the other cut modules: which members are getters (`engine`, `getServicesRegistry`), which are callbacks (`packagePersistService`, `packageInstallUndo`), the three helpers that moved with the bodies, and the two `protocol.ts` declarations it imports. Comment only; that file has no other change.
- The class docblock of `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` keeps its `{@link carryForwardRedactedValues}`, which `protocol.ts` no longer imports. The docblock is unchanged by design (move-only); the link names the function in `metadata-redaction.ts`.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 8, plus one: public members whose return type is inferred, the bodies kept by a reader (`probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, and now `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`), and the private-static readers stay in `protocol.ts`.
